AUTHOR: Westergerling
TITLE: Effects of fish behaviour on abundance and length frequency estimates from in-trawl stereo cameras
REGION: Norwegian Sea (IESNS 2018; Iceland-Faroe Ridge, Voring Plateau, Lofoten Basin)
SPECIES: Atlantic herring, blue whiting, mesopelagic fishes (Maurolicus muelleri, Benthosema glaciale, myctophids), Atlantic mackerel (detector class)
DATA: Deep Vision in-trawl stereo images, 3 pelagic trawl stations of IESNS May 2018 (~120k images); 3674 manual annotations
V_EV: Image collection: 'synchronised LED strobes for illumination, and a depth sensor'; Table 2 depth per trawl layer; distance to camera computed per fish (Eq. 4)
D_EV: no statement found (pre-trained RetinaNet of Allken et al. 2021 applied; no training/test split in this paper)
R_EV: Datasets (p.4): 'The same images were also analysed using the RetinaNet deep learning algorithm developed by Allken et al. (2021)'. Allken 2021 trained and tested on the May 2017/2018 cruises (same campaign), so single-domain.
C_EV: Table 6: 'with a score threshold of 0.47'; Table 5 contrasts automatic detections with manual individuals/objects ('repeated detections ... result in inflated counts')
E_EV: Fig. 9/Table 5: composition of taxa 'calculated from three different methods: manual IA, trawl catches, and detections generated by RetinaNet'
ARCH: RetinaNet detector (Allken et al. 2021), image-by-image, no tracking
METR: Recall per taxon (confusion matrix vs manual annotations), detection counts vs manual counts vs catch, relative composition
NOTE: Mainly a manual image-analysis/behaviour study; AI component = off-the-shelf RetinaNet (Allken 2021) evaluated by recall (46-88%). Training data of that model not described here; if it excluded IESNS 2018, R1 would be Y (authors compare with Allken 2021 recall values 72/82/89%). Independent reference = trawl catch counts (Table 5, Fig. 9). C5 credited because duplicate (recurrence) counting is quantified (detections 2-13x individuals) and FP mackerel detections listed; no precision/FP rate. Threshold 0.47 not justified in this paper. ENV pelagic 200-360 m (no fitting value) -> NR. NIMG = images recorded at 3 stations.
AUTHORS_FULL: Westergerling, T; Tenningen, M; Enberg, K; Rosen, SP
